newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO restarts 1.1 mln kw Niigata reactor.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO restarts 1.1 mln kw Niigata reactor.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Monday it had restarted its 1.1 million kilowatt (kw) reactor at the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata Prefecture on the Sea of Japan coast.
"We put the unit back on line on Sunday night. It's expected to reach its full capacity by noon on Wednesday," a TEPCO spokesman said.
The reactor, one of seven units at the plant, had been closed since late June for routine maintenance checks.
The Kashiwazaki-Kariwa complex is the world's largest nuclear power station with a combined generating capacity of 8.2 million kw.
